zh.title: 美國運輸部長於紐瓦克與華盛頓機場啟用新地表移動雷達
zh.summary: 運輸部部長宣布於紐瓦克與華盛頓機場安裝SMR-4雷達；旨在提升地面追蹤能力並防止跑道侵入
body: 美國運輸部長 Sean P. Duffy 已於紐瓦克自由國際機場 (EWR) 與羅納德·里根華盛頓國家機場 (DCA) 分別啟用全新的地表移動雷達 (SMR)。
此次安裝的設備型號為 SMR-4，可讓空管人員在各種天氣與能見度條件下，追蹤跑道及滑行道上的飛機與車輛。
紐瓦克機場的 SMR-4 是全美第五座安裝此型號的機場；而華盛頓機場的安裝則屬於美國現代化空中交通控制系統計畫的一部分。
根據美國聯邦航空局 (FAA) 資料，紐瓦克機場將在未來三年內獲得 3,000 萬美元資金用於升級；華盛頓機場則將獲得 3,050 萬美元資金。

en.title: U.S. Transportation Secretary Unveils New Surface Movement Radar at EWR and DCA
en.summary: Secretary Duffy unveils SMR-4 radar at Newark and Reagan National; aimed at improving ground tracking and preventing runway incursions
body: U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy has unveiled new Surface Movement Radar (SMR) installations at Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR) and Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport (DCA).
The new SMR-4 technology enables air traffic controllers to track aircraft and vehicles on runways and taxiways under all weather and visibility conditions.
The installation at EWR marks the fifth SMR-4 unit deployed nationwide, while the DCA installation is part of broader efforts to modernize the U.S. air traffic control system.
Newark is scheduled to receive $30 million for upgrades over the next three years, while Reagan National will receive $30.5 million for critical safety and modernization projects.

facts.claim: U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy unveiled a new Surface Movement Radar (SMR) at Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR).
facts.sourceQuote: U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy and Federal Aviation Administrator Bryan Bedford today unveiled Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR)’s brand-new Surface Movement Radar (SMR).

facts.claim: The new radar at EWR is the SMR-4 model, which allows tracking of aircraft and vehicles in all weather and visibility conditions.
facts.sourceQuote: The Surface Movement Radar Model 4 (SMR-4) will allow air traffic controllers to track aircraft and vehicles on runways and taxiways in all weather and visibility conditions.

facts.claim: The SMR-4 at EWR is the fifth of its kind installed nationwide.
facts.sourceQuote: EWR’s SMR-4 is the fifth to be installed so far nationwide.

facts.claim: Secretary Duffy announced the installation of a new Surface Movement Radar (SMR) at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport (DCA).
facts.sourceQuote: U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy today announced the installation of a new Surface Movement Radar (SMR) at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport (DCA).

facts.claim: DCA is the fifth airport to receive a Surface Movement Radar Model 4 (SMR-4).
facts.sourceQuote: DCA is the fifth airport to receive a Surface Movement Radar Model 4 (SMR-4)

facts.claim: DCA will receive $30.5 million for upgrades over the next three years.
facts.sourceQuote: Trump’s Transportation Department will invest $30.5 million into DCA from the Working Families Tax Cuts Act over the next three years
